meta.description: WSK-12 (docs/blueprints/webdesk-design.md §03/§10). Zone B (WebDesk) signed fact webhook -> HMAC verify on the RAW BYTES BEFORE any JSON parse -> schema-check -> dedup via mcp-hub's webdev.recordZoneBEvent tool (webdev_zoneb_event_log's UNIQUE(tenant_id,event_id)) -> route: form.received -> optional notify. THE SECURITY INVARIANT (§03): a forged/replayed/mutated/wrong-timestamp payload is refused BEFORE parse and can cause at most a notification + a log row, never a privileged transition. Scoped identity wf:webdesk-zoneb-intake -> [webdev.recordZoneBEvent, notify] (mcp-hub automation-policy.ts allow-list entry -- reported in the WSK-12 ticket output, not made here). GATED: the MCP dedup call is inert unless WEBDEV_ZONEB_INTAKE_ENABLED=1, same doctrine as on-inbound-lead.json's INGEST_ENABLED gate -- do not enable until the webdev.recordZoneBEvent tool + wf:webdesk-zoneb-intake account genuinely exist (WSK-19/31, not this ticket). Env: WEBDESK_EVENT_SECRET, WEBDEV_ZONEB_EVENT_TOLERANCE_MS, WEBDEV_ZONEB_INTAKE_ENABLED, HUB_SERVICE_TOKEN, WEBDEV_ZONEB_NOTIFY_RECIPIENT_ID (optional).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 2, method: "tools/call", params: { name: "notify", arguments: { tenantId: $json.envelope.tenantId, recipientId: $env.WEBDEV_ZONEB_NOTIFY_RECIPIENT_ID, type: "wd_zoneb_form_received", payload: { siteSlug: $json.envelope.data.siteSlug, formId: $json.envelope.data.formId, submissionId: $json.envelope.data.submissionId } } } }) }}
